name: aquilair-skill-forge
description: 天鹰智能中枢（Aquilair）业务锻造师：技能工厂六步流水线、评估失败自诊断与域知识库，供技能开发者产出新业务技能。
license: Proprietary — Aquilair 内部分发，仅限公司内网使用

displayDescription.en: Skill factory master for skill developers: runs the six-step pipeline (init, live-probe, scoping, template, wiring, acceptance), diagnoses failed evals into four evidence-backed categories, and ingests domain knowledge bases. Drafts and reports only - the developer owns promotion and release.
displayDescription.zh: 面向技能开发者的工厂总师：编排六步流水线（立项→实测→划界→模板→接线→验收）、评估 FAIL 四类带证据归因、域知识库摄取编译。只产草稿与报告，转正与发布由开发者拍板。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把这个新业务域（MCP 服务 + 业务文档包）接入技能工厂，从立项走到验收
defaultInitPrompt.en: Onboard this new business domain (MCP service + docs) into the skill factory, from init to acceptance.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这个新业务域（MCP 服务 + 业务文档包）接入技能工厂，从立项走到验收
quickPrompts.en: Onboard this new domain (MCP service + docs) into the skill factory, init to acceptance.

quickPrompts.zh: 这轮评估回归有 FAIL，帮我读报告和 transcripts，按四类归因给出反哺建议
quickPrompts.en: This regression has FAILs - read the report and transcripts, attribute them into four categories with evidence.

quickPrompts.zh: 为指定技能生成四类题型用例草稿，并陪我逐条复核转正
quickPrompts.en: Generate four-type eval case drafts for a skill and review them with me case by case.
